Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_10216",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag",
    "line":617,"var":"pkcs12->pkcs12","code":"result = _decode_pkcs12_auth_safe(pkcs12->pkcs12, &c2, NULL);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled DER data decoded into ASN1 structure from fuzzer-provided PKCS12 blob"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag",
    "line":648,"var":"bag","code":"result = _parse_safe_contents(c2, root2, bag);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Dispatches parsing of the DATA_OID content into _parse_safe_contents"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_parse_safe_contents",
    "line":571,"var":"content","code":"result = _pkcs12_decode_safe_contents(&content, bag);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Passes extracted octet string content to _pkcs12_decode_safe_contents"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
    "line":378,"var":"attributes","code":"int count = 0, attributes, j;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Variable attributes is declared without initialization; if asn1_number_of_elements returns ASN1_ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND for absent optional bagAttributes, the variable remains uninitialized"},
   {"step":5,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
    "line":473,"var":"attributes","code":"if (attributes < 0) attributes = 1;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Use-of-uninitialized-value: reads attributes without it having been set when bagAttributes is absent from input"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag",
     "line":617,"operands":["pkcs12->pkcs12"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
     "line":378,"operands":["attributes","0"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"attributes","right":"0"}},
   "sink":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
     "line":473,"operands":["attributes","0"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"attributes","right":"0"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag",
       "line":617,"operands":["pkcs12->pkcs12"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
       "line":378,"operands":["attributes"]},
      "type":"data","via":["content->data"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"content->data","right":"auth_safe.data"}},
     {"from":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
       "line":378,"operands":["attributes"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents",
       "line":473,"operands":["attributes"]},
      "type":"data","via":["attributes"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"attributes","right":"attributes"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
